_: Copy to <repo-parent>/medata-corpus/refmodel.json and pin the models you actually have access to. This file is the example, not the configuration: the real one names base URLs, local checkpoints and key environment variables, which are facts about one machine and do not belong in the repo.
_active: Decision 16: exactly one adapter reads per cycle. Switching is an edit to this key — cached readings survive, and the new ident starts its own comparison series rather than joining the old one.
_openai: The base URL is how a local OpenAI-compatible server is reached — point it at http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio and pin the model it serves. No separate adapter exists for local runtimes, by decision.
_parity: Every enabled adapter is health-probed with one image per cycle and the result goes into the verdict, so a standby that stopped working is found before it is needed.
